title: Colorful Boats
description: Lets you change the color of boats
body:
# Colorful Boats
Do you want to have new colorful boats but are annoyed of having to add a million new wood types just for new boats? No worry, this is not needed anymore.
This mod will allow you to change the look of every boat or raft in the game.
You have multiple options for the color on your boats.
UI can opened via **B Key**

1. You can give every boat the color you want, so when not changed any toggle, every boat uses the color
2. You can right-click any boat, then it will use its own color and no the selected on in the Color UI
3. You can turn off the whole mod or that only boats you right-clicked will use the color

## Missing Feature
Currently when you right-click a boat with dye and then break it, the boat will lose its color and when placed again, its back to normal without the dye you used on it. This bug will hopefully be fixed.

## Color UI
![Colorful Boats UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5afee736973d8fbf25918b39b272f4177c18e5c_0.webp)

## Boat Textures
Every Boat now has two versions of its texture. This simple means you can select If a boat looks more tinted (Vanilla Texture) or clean (White Version) when the color is enabled. 
You can very easily see which texture mode is enabled, and change it whenever you want. 

### Vanilla Texture

![Vanilla Texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6113b6b2ccc26ba1ecf8037756c127d2791b1cd9.png)

### White Texture

![White Version](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/785ba832c55d32371166317ca21755374c211aa6.png)

## Enable Specific Boats
The mod allows you to right-click boats and when you want only these boats to use the color and not every boat that spawns in the world, simply turn off the global toggle in the UI.
![Enabled boats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6166ebf7af58cbe25dc7d909061c35673837f08d.png)
